main_text.p: [1. Quòd-si post ε sequatur vocalis longa, vel diphthongus : crasis fit, absorpto ε, & remanente vocali longâ vel diphthongo. ut: ποιέω, ποιῶ: ποιέεις, ποιεῖς: ποιέ-ηται, ποιῆτον: ποιέσμεν, ποιῶμεν.
Si post ε sequatur aliud ε: crasis fit in ει diphthongum. ut: ποιέετε, ποιεῖτε. Praeterquàm in duali numero Nominum: ubi crasis fit in η. ut: τείχεε, τείχη.
Si post ε sequatur o: crasis fit in ω. ut: πίχεῳ, πίχως.
Si denique post ε sequatur α: crasis fit in η. ut: τείχεα, τείχη. Praeterquàm in Accusativis pluralibus, in ας terminantibus: in quibus crasis fit in εα. ut: βασιλέας, βασιλεῖς.
2. Quòd-si post o sequatur α, η, aut ω: crasis fit in ω. ut: αὐδρόα, αὐδρῶ: χρυσόω, χρυσῶ: χρησόησθον, χρυσῶτον.
Si post o sequatur ε, o, aut diphthongus υ: crasis fit in υ. ut: χρύσοε, χρύσυ: χρυ-σοον, χρύσυν: χρησόυ, χρησῦ.
Si deniq; post o sequatur diphthongus ει, οι, aut η: crasis fit in οι. ut: χρυσόεις, χρυσοῖς: χρησόοις, χρυσοῖς: χρησόης, χρησοῖς. Excepto Infinitivo praesenti tertiae conjugationis

page.notes: Greek text is printed in a small, worn type; several accents and breathings are uncertain. Greek transcription is approximate and marked as doubtful where unclear. A reference mark appears at the left margin near section 2.
